justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/jsoup/helper/RequestDispatch.java and src/main/java/org/jsoup/helper/HttpConnection.java. RequestDispatch is a very small package-private shim (49 lines) with one static field, one static initializer, and a single factory method get(...); its only responsibility is choosing between HttpClientExecutor and UrlConnectionExecutor based on a system property and sslSocketFactory. HttpConnection.java shows one call site at execute() using it as a simple dispatch helper. There is no evidence of many methods, multiple responsibilities, or low cohesion, so insufficient modularization is not present.
